2292-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ornithopter, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1170-5131-5330-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

880-4826-7893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4826-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

967-997-3809-7087-7824.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

997-1263-2301-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-4289-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-5195-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-5195-7577.description:
Cast a copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Emeritus of Truce.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares.
When Emeritus of Truce enters, it triggers, causing a player to create a 1/1 Inkling creature with flying, then becoming prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.
1170-5195-7577.notes: The exact results and the targeting choices you make in steps 1 and 4 depend on the board state, since you need to ensure that an opponent always has more creatures than you by the end of step 4.

457-1792-4404-7057.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-7057.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

222-2511-4871--73.easyPrerequisites:
The persist or undying creature doesn't have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, respective to its ability.
You control a Saproling.
222-2511-4871--73.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the persist or undying creature and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and the other creature's persist or undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying or persist creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

38-206-659.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-206-659.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

967-2097-3809-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2558-2921-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

57-969-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-969-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4017-4659-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-4017-4659-6458.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1594-3532-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

427-1978-2750.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-1978-2750.description:
Cause Kydele to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat from step 2.

985-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

104-3197-3330.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

116-3680-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Stunt Double on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Stunt Double do not have summoning sickness.
116-3680-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Stunt Double.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Stunt Double.
Activate Stunt Double by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Stunt Double ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6173.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6173.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Prowling Felidar trigger.
Resolve the Prowling Felidar trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

974-2816-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Umbral Mantle attached to Ghired.
974-2816-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Ghired by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
974-2816-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn. You may also attach Umbral Mantle to another nontoken creature you control to make it infinitely large.

1778-2034-2055-3263.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {2}, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2275-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2275-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3180-4934-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Chamber Sentry from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1376-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Priest of Titania.
You control at least two Elves.
1283-1376-3525.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

1479-2374-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

168-372-2902.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
168-372-2902.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Oblivion Ring until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Journey to Nowhere from exile to the battlefield.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Journey to Nowhere.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4188-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You have gained at least four life this turn.
618-4188-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate the Accomplished Alchemist token's second ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

3718-4258.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible non-creature permanent.
3718-4258.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting any indestructible non-creature permanent you control.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the indestructible permanent and choosing to copy Chain of Acid, targeting the indestructible permanent with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1283-2034-3841.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake for {1}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier token, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2275-3863-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Hard Cover attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
2275-3863-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card and discarding a card.
When you draw a card, Shabraz will trigger, gaining you 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

2371-3055-5145.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
2371-3055-5145.description:
Sacrifice Archon of Falling Stars to Heroism.
Archon of Falling Stars dying triggers its death effect and Gift of Immortality.
Place Archon of Falling Stars' trigger onto the stack under the Gift of Immortality trigger targeting Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger returning Archon of Falling Stars to the battlefield.
Then resolve Archon of Falling Stars' trigger, returning Gift of Immortality to the battlefield.
When it returns, attach it to Archon of Falling Stars.
Repeat all previous steps for an infinite loop.

3011-3333-4522.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-3333-4522.notablePrerequisites: At least four quest counters on Quest for the Pure Flame.
3011-3333-4522.description:
Activate Quest for the Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling damage sources you control will deal this turn.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you that does not change your life total due to Platinum Emperion.
